    def compare(left,right,targets=None,observables=False):
        result=dict(left=left,right=right,targets=targets,passed=None)

    outer_targets={k:plan['outer_extent_control']['maximum_pointwise_n_v_incident_flux_relative_target'] for k in FIELDS}
    spatial_pairs=[('ct96_w30','ct96_w30_phi144'),('ct96_w30_phi144','ct96_w30_phi192'),
                   ('ct96_w30_phi192','ct96_w30_theta32_phi192'),('ct96_w30_theta32_phi192','ct128_w30_theta32_phi192')]
    physics=['cooler','hotter','density_low','density_high','gamma53','Bzero','frozenBr26','cme12','cme24']
    result=dict(author='Codex-root',created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                time_convention='observer_arrival',case_root=str(args.case_root.resolve()),
                decision='Comparison audit only; no reference selection or uncertainty interval is inferred.',

                temporal=dict(comparisons=[compare('ct96_w30_half','ct96_w30',time_targets)]),
                initial_condition=dict(comparisons=[compare('ct96_w30_start6','ct96_w30',initial_targets)]),
                outer_extent=dict(comparisons=[compare('ct96_w30_outer','ct96_w30',outer_targets)]),
                spatial=dict(comparisons=[compare(a,b,plan['conditional_coordinate_refinement']['maximum_pointwise_relative_targets'],True) for a,b in spatial_pairs],
                             qualification='These coordinate comparisons apply to30deg only if domain eligibility passes; missing/failed tests remain explicit.'),
                physics=dict(comparisons=[compare('ct96_w30_'+label,'ct96_w30') for label in physics]+[compare('ct96_w30_cme12','ct96_w30_cme24')],
                             interpretation='Conditional physical/input sensitivities, with no pass flag and no confidence-interval interpretation.'),
                input_sha256={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),ROOT/'scripts/postprocess.py',ROOT/'scripts/observer_clock.py',ROOT/'scripts/run_records.py',ROOT/'observations/xmm_gtis.tsv',ROOT/'observations/ephemeris_comet.tsv',ROOT/'observations/ephemeris_wind.tsv',ROOT/'observations/coordinate_system.json']})
